en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abdul Rahman Bin Al hajjal, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The habitual (drinker of) the wine would meet Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High on the Day he meets Him<sup>azwj</sup>, like an idol worshipper’.
en.sarwar: 6. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajj aj who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
A wine addict will meet Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, as a worshipper of idols will do.’”
